# Wheel support on Linux

Force feedback support by wheel, summarised from the community-tested [linux-steering-wheels](https://github.com/JacKeTUs/linux-steering-wheels) table (as of 2026-09-22). Platinum is best. Pitwall's **Pre-race checks** identify your wheel and tell you which driver it needs.

## What Pitwall controls

- **MOZA**: Full settings, rev lights, auto setup
- **Logitech**: Rotation; gain/spring/damper/friction with new-lg4ff; rev lights on G27/G29
- **Fanatec**: Rotation and tuning menu (hid-fanatecff)
- **Thrustmaster**: Rotation, gain, spring/damper/friction (hid-tmff2)
